# NativeModLoader binary

`bink2w64.dll` is the DOS2 NativeModLoader proxy distributed with
[Ch4nKyy/DOS2WASD](https://github.com/Ch4nKyy/DOS2WASD).

SHA-256: `6C2932D54E56DCB1A6E9E0D9CD13C2DBACB9BDF9D4175B0BCBB0E0CAB0FC20FC`.

The installer never distributes the game's original Bink library. It renames
the user's existing `bink2w64.dll` to `bink2w64_original.dll` and restores it on
uninstall.
